engagement_title: Northwind Advisory spring rebuild: bring three sitting mornings to one firm, rerun the retired printer's adviser introduction card for the current eight, and hand back the team page, the capabilities leave-behind and the announcement posts as something the office can edit
vertical: Professional services, boutique institutional wealth advisory, eight advisers on one floor (Boston, Massachusetts)
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com posting 'Traditional Corporate Headshot Session Needed', asking for classic formal corporate head shots on a neutral light grey backdrop, colour plus clean black and white versions, and deliverables sized for social profile, company website and print on a one week turnaround. Co-anchor: the Freelancer.com corporate website retouch open call asking a freelancer to 'professionally enhance a complete set of images for our corporate website', to 'correct lighting imbalances and exposure issues', to 'create a consistent visual style across all website images', and to 'maintain a natural and realistic appearance'. Neither posting names a client or attaches images, so the firm is laundered to the coined fictional Northwind Advisory Partners. The ledger's earlier draft carried invented staff names drawn from South Asian and West African naming, which fails this benchmark's Western cultural frame, so every person is re-coined into English, German, Dutch, Nordic, French and Spanish naming and the office is placed in Boston. Verdict STRENGTHEN: the ledger concept sat almost entirely on one surface (retouch a set, lay it out). What both real clients actually needed is the whole run of pages a firm is judged by plus the printed leave-behind that goes with them, and the connector reaches all of it, because a flat press PDF converts back into a live merge template and HTML authoring produces a native editable document the office can maintain.
client_one_liner: Eight of us were photographed across three separate mornings and we look like three different firms, our printer has retired and left us only the press files for the card we leave behind, and the new site goes live in six weeks.
client_brief:
Northwind Advisory Partners, about and team pages

We are eight people on one floor on Federal Street. We advise endowments, foundations and around forty families, and most mandates we win start with somebody reading our team page and deciding whether we look like a firm they can place a hundred million dollars with.

The site is rebuilt in six weeks and the pages that carry us are not ready. Photographs were taken across three separate mornings because nobody could get all eight of us in the building at once, and it shows. Two sittings ran against the grey backdrop in the small conference room, one ran by the windows on a bright morning, and one partner was travelling so his assistant sent something in. They do not look like one firm. We want eight people who plainly work in the same room, on the same plain ground, cropped the same way. We want them to look like us. Nothing smoothed, nothing slimmed, no glow.

We need the team page, an about and capabilities page we can also print and hand across a table, and something for the professional networks when we announce a hire or a mandate. The capabilities page carries our sectors and the credentials each adviser holds, laid out so a trustee reads it without effort. Those change, so we have to edit them ourselves without calling anybody.

Our printer ran an introduction card for each adviser, the one we leave behind after a first meeting. She has retired. All we have are the two press files she sent us, one from 2024 and one from 2025. Keep that card and rerun it for the current eight, with a proof of each and a separate file per adviser so we can reprint one person.

We also need one photograph of a room, not a portrait, for the top of the capabilities page. We have never had one.

One more thing about our mark. The new site needs the little browser icon, the professional networks want a square badge for the announcements, the printed card carries the mark in the corner and the letterhead needs it across the top. Today it only exists as the one lockup off the old site and the letterpress card, plus a folder we had foil stamped with just the compass rose on it, and the little icon our last web person made is a fuzzy blur at any size. We need the mark as a proper set we can hand to a printer or a web person and have it come out crisp wherever it lands, large or small.

Please write down what you did to the pictures and what type we are on.
price_band_and_audience: Boutique institutional advisory billing 350 to 600 dollars an hour, buyers are endowment trustees, foundation investment committees and families with 20 million dollars and up. The band is load-bearing. At this tier the portraiture is understated and uniform, the ground is a plain neutral, the crop is identical on all eight, skin is left alone, and the page is sober with wide margins and a credentials table a trustee can read. Pushed up into luxury editorial (dramatic side light, near-black grounds, heavy vignettes, one hero partner larger than the rest) it reads as a personal brand rather than a fiduciary, and a committee reads that as risk. Pushed down into startup about-us (bright saturated grounds, playful crops, mismatched candid frames, oversized first names) it reads as a firm that does not custody other people's money. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every merge field binds. A real posting of this shape runs 1,600 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: Boutique institutional wealth advisory serving endowments, foundations and around forty families.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2009, Boston, Massachusetts, eight advisers on one floor on Federal Street.
brand_identity.about: Northwind Advisory Partners advises endowments, foundations and around forty families on the long term stewardship of institutional and family capital. We are eight people on one floor, and most mandates we win begin with a trustee reading our team page and deciding whether we look like a firm they can place a hundred million dollars with. The brand exists to signal exactly that: a fiduciary, uniform, unshowy, credentialled, judged by a committee rather than an audience.
brand_identity.audience: Endowment trustees, foundation investment committees and families with twenty million dollars and up. Readers aged 45 to 75, most of them reading printed pages and reviewing a credentials table before a mandate is placed.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Billed 350 to 600 dollars an hour. Boutique institutional tier: understated and fiduciary, deliberately not luxury editorial personal branding and not startup about us.
brand_identity.typography: One classical system: a restrained transitional serif for the firm name, headings and the credentials table, paired with a quiet sans for labels and contact lines. Wide margins, generous leading, a text size a trustee reads without effort. No display face, no oversized first names.
brand_identity.voice: Measured, plain, institutional. Speaks of stewardship and process, never of performance promises. Example line the firm would write: We advise a small number of institutions and families on capital they intend to hold for generations. No superlatives, no exclamation points.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
brand_identity.values: Fiduciary stewardship above all, and a uniform, sober face that reads as one firm rather than eight individuals.

assets_supplied.name: sittings/ (8 portraits, mixed 6000 x 4000 and one 1400 x 1050)
assets_supplied.kind: Corporate portraits of the eight advisers made across three mornings: two sittings against the grey conference room backdrop, one sitting by the north windows, one frame sent in remotely by a partner's assistant.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Three mornings, one office, and they do not look like one firm. Two on the grey, one lot by the windows, and Hartmann's came in from his assistant."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two sitters wear mid grey suiting and one of those has silver hair, sitting within a hair of the backdrop's own value, so a knockout onto a house ground succeeds cleanly on six and quietly eats shoulder edge and hairline on those two. Separately the remotely supplied frame arrives at 1400 px because it was cropped inside an email client, which is under the card's print need, and the frame shot by the windows carries two illuminants inside one exposure.

assets_supplied.name: adviser_card_2024_press.pdf and adviser_card_2025_press.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The retired printer's two flat press files for the 85 x 55 mm adviser introduction card, fonts embedded, produced from real page layouts. Both print identically: name, credentials line, practice line, direct dial, email and a portrait.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Both of these are the card. She reissued it in 2025 and I could never see what changed. Keep the card, just rerun it for the eight of us."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The two files are not the same document underneath. One was built with the portrait placed as a linked graphic, so it converts into separated text frames plus a real graphic frame with an integer item id that a per adviser photograph can bind to. The other was flattened before it went to press, so it converts into a single continuous text story with no graphic frame at all and cannot carry a per record portrait by any route. Nothing on the printed card, in the file names or in the page geometry says which is which.

assets_supplied.name: roster_export.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the practice management system, one row per adviser, with columns for legal name, preferred name, title, credential designations, practice sectors, direct dial, email and a portrait filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Straight out of the system. The credentials on the card have to be exactly right, they are regulated."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The export carries nine rows for eight advisers because an associate who left in January is still flagged active, and two rows carry the legal name where the card has always run the preferred name. The credential designations are punctuated three different ways across the rows, and the portrait column is a plain header holding bare filenames that neither match the delivered frames nor satisfy the merge's own image column contract.

assets_supplied.name: northwind_mark/ (mark artwork, 2 files)
assets_supplied.kind: The firm's compass rose and wordmark: one flat 2400 px PNG export, and one photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for, lying on a desk.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our mark. The flat one came off the old site. The other is the card the mark was first made for, which we like better."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The two files need opposite instruments: the flat export traces directly, while the photographed card returns the paper rather than the ink unless the selection names the mark's own colour and drawn character rather than the object it sits on, and the compass rose's enclosed counters cannot be punched by a background removal at all.

assets_supplied.name: northwind_folder_foil.jpg (foil-blocked presentation folder, compass rose alone)
assets_supplied.kind: A photograph of the firm's foil-blocked presentation folder cover, carrying the compass-rose emblem on its own at large scale with no wordmark: the only high-fidelity rendering of the emblem by itself, and the source the small formats need.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The folder we hand things across the table in. That is the compass on its own, big and clean. The little website icon our last person made is useless, it is a blur at any size."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The emblem is brass foil, not flat ink: bright metallic hits ride the raised edges and fall to dark bronze in the recessed shanks, so a selection by the object grabs only the brightest foil and drops the shanks, a raw trace shatters the emblem into a dozen banded sub-paths, and the deboss shadow around it makes a background removal grab the cover rather than the mark. The emblem recovers only if the selection names the compass rose's own drawn character and its foil gradient is flattened to the single Compass Brass ink before tracing, and its centre ring and point gaps cannot be punched. The old developer's favicon is a decoy: tracing or enlarging it produces mush.

assets_supplied.name: credentials_and_sectors.txt
assets_supplied.kind: The office manager's list of the firm's six sectors and, per adviser, the designations held and the year admitted.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What goes in the table on the capabilities page."

acceptance_bar: The eight read as one firm when laid together in the grid the team page runs them in: one ground, one white point, one crop, one head size in the frame. A sitter who cannot be brought to the set is named, not shipped at eighty percent.

Every knocked out portrait holds at the edge the shoulder and the hairline actually make. A knockout that reports success but eats a shoulder is a failed portrait, and it is judged in the grid, not on its own.
Skin is left as skin. No smoothing, no slimming, no glow, no eye brightening. A portrait that has been beautified fails whatever else is right about it.

No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions, and no crop or knockout tradeoff record carries an upscale or a downscale entry that went unreported. Where a frame could not reach a required size, the note says so and says what was done instead.

Exactly one printed introduction card per current adviser, in roster order, with no card for anyone who has left and none missing. If the count shipped is not the count we gave you, the note says which row was dropped and why.

Every card carries the adviser's own portrait, and no card repeats another card's portrait. Every credential designation is reproduced exactly as the system holds it, with nothing abbreviated, expanded or repunctuated.
Every card runs the preferred name the adviser is actually introduced by, not the legal name, wherever the two differ.
Each per adviser file contains the adviser its filename claims, established by opening the file rather than by the order the files came back in.
The proofs are rendered at true print resolution at card trim, not at screen scale.

The team page, the capabilities page and the announcement posts come back as one native editable document we can add a partner to, with every photograph actually visible in it, the sectors and credentials as a real table, and every text element carrying its licensed face at that family's own numeric weight.
The room photograph sits with the eight portraits as one commission rather than as a stock interior dropped in, judged at full resolution beside them, not at thumbnail.

The mark is delivered as a working family, not a single lockup: a primary vertical lockup, a standalone compass-rose emblem, a horizontal lockup and a reversed Paper White colourway for the navy ground, every one placeable on a coloured ground with the compass rose's centre ring and triangular point gaps intact and no opaque background rectangle riding along.

Every derived mark format holds at its own reproduction size: the eight compass points stay separate and the centre ring stays open at favicon scale and at the printed card-corner size, and no small-format mark ships as a filled blob. Where the full-detail emblem could not survive at a size, the note says so and says what simplified emblem was substituted.

A written note: the parameters applied per sitter with one line on why that sitter differs, the type system by role, what each press file actually turned out to be and which one the card run was built on, every roster row questioned and how it was resolved, and every resize any tool reported.

adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload / asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_apply_auto_tone, image_select_by_prompt (returnBbox), image_select_subject, image_invert_selection, image_remove_background (transparent and backgroundColor), image_fill_area, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize (reading tradeoffs, detection_confidence, upscale_factor), image_vectorize, image_apply_color_overlay (reversed colourway and avatar tile), change_background_color
adobe_surfaces.role: Brings three sitting mornings to one house target with a call per sitter rather than one batched pass, since a single parameter set corrects the grey backdrop pair and takes the window sitting cold. Runs confined corrections where a frame holds two illuminants. Puts all eight on one house ground and cuts one identical head and shoulders crop at native scale. Also recovers the firm's mark from three supplied renderings, which need three different instruments (the flat export traces, the letterpress card needs an ink-colour selection, the foil folder needs the metallic gradient flattened before it will trace), and rebuilds it into a working family: a primary vertical lockup, a standalone compass-rose emblem, a horizontal lockup and a reversed colourway for the navy ground. Then derives the multi-format production kit the rebuild carries the mark in (favicon-scale raster, square social-avatar tile, print card-corner mark, letterhead and footer vector), proving each variant at its own true reproduction size because a vector legible at lockup scale fuses the eight points and fills the centre ring at favicon and card-corner size. Also derives the crop families for page, card and post.

adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml (on both press files, then again to audit the prepared template), generate_indd_mapping_prompt (as generator and as validator), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout (application/x-indesign and application/pdf, additionalImageFiles, recordRange), document_render_layout (resolution 300, createSeparateFiles, pageRange in N-N form)
adobe_surfaces.role: The print spine. Two look alike press files are the only surviving record of the leave-behind card, and only one of them can become a merge template that binds a per adviser portrait. The roster export becomes the data source, and the run produces the press cards in roster order, the per adviser single files, and the 300 DPI proofs the office signs off from. This is the only surface here that does record per page variable data, and the true story text must be reconstructed from the exported interchange file rather than trusted from a convenience readout.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, html_export_readiness_skill, asset upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express({url}), asset_search (CCAsset), asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: The pages the firm is judged by, as one native editable document at four canvas sizes: the team page, the A4 capabilities leave-behind carrying the sectors and credentials as a genuine table, and the square and four by five announcement posts. Every portrait carried as embedded image data because a URL renders as an empty grey box at full success, family and weight declared per text element, each root declaring its own canvas size, payload routed by uploaded URL because eight inlined portraits pass the inline threshold.

adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend (once per typographic role), font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: The type system across the team page, the leave-behind and the posts, and the only place the agent's typographic authorship exists at all, since no font from this surface can reach the printed card and the card's typography therefore remains the retired printer's. The recommender refuses to pair, numeric weights are non standard per family, one bad name kills the entire kit, and the CSS must carry the returned slug rather than the PostScript name.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (StockAsset, short query, contentType filter, orientation never passed), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the room photograph the firm has never had, IP clean and at camera scale, with generative tech candidates excluded and the register judged against an institutional buyer rather than against a stock thumbnail. The Boards half persists the shared set the partners review from, placed within the twelve per call cap with a partial success read as partial.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable belongs to which surface: the introduction card to the merge surface because it is record per page against a layout the client wants kept, the pages and posts to authored fixed canvases because the office must edit credentials itself, the portraits to imaging.
trajectory.judgement: Authoring the card from scratch throws away the layout the client explicitly asked to keep. Trying to merge the pages finds that record per page cannot produce four different canvas sizes or an editable table.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming the surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier.

trajectory.action: Upload the eight portraits, both press files, the roster export, the credentials list and both mark files and the foil presentation-folder photograph, holding every returned presigned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A manifest keyed by role and by person, so that forty artefacts later the agent still knows which URL is whose portrait.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and adviser.

trajectory.action: Preview all eight frames and triage: which sitting each belongs to, which carry more than one illuminant inside the exposure, which are off level, native pixel scale per frame, and how much headroom each frame gives a common crop.
trajectory.judgement: The client says three mornings; the useful distinction is how many lights are in each exposure and how much frame each gives, because those decide whether a global correction is the right instrument and whether one identical crop is reachable across all eight.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note: sitting, illuminant count, tilt, native scale, available headroom.

trajectory.action: Straighten the frames that sit off level before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes and eats edge pixels, and the remotely supplied frame has the least edge to spare.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed.

trajectory.action: Fix one house target off the strongest conference room frame and correct each of the eight toward it with its own call, logging the parameters applied.
trajectory.judgement: The target is a set, not eight optimisations. The window sitting needs a materially different move from the backdrop sittings to land in the same place, and the agent has to hold one destination rather than make each frame individually pleasing.
trajectory.produces: Eight corrected masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Run confined corrections where a whole frame move is the wrong instrument: the window frame carrying daylight on one cheek and room light on the other, and the sitter whose spectacles throw a hard specular.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the entire gate. Naming the object pulls the selection to the object, naming the thing's own visual character pulls it to the thing itself, and a fringing mask has to be read as fringing rather than accepted because the call reported success.
trajectory.produces: Corrected frames where a global move would have taken the backdrop blue or the skin orange.

trajectory.action: Put all eight onto one house ground and cut the single identical head and shoulders crop at native scale, reading every returned tradeoff record for upscale and downscale entries.
trajectory.judgement: One ground and one crop across eight sitters of different heights, builds and framings is the whole point of the grid, and the crop has to be judged on where it puts the eyes rather than on filling the box.
trajectory.produces: Eight portraits on one ground at one crop, with the tradeoff records captured per frame.

trajectory.action: Recover the firm's mark from both supplied files, treating them as the different problems they are, and produce one placeable scalable version with the counters intact.
trajectory.judgement: The flat export traces; the photographed card returns paper unless the selection names the mark's own colour and drawn character. The raw trace also arrives with an opaque background path and no viewBox, so a mark that looks correct in isolation shows a white box the moment it lands on the page's ground.
trajectory.produces: One clean placeable mark plus a note on why the two files needed different handling.

trajectory.action: Recover the standalone compass-rose emblem the small formats need. The recovered lockup carries the emblem at lockup scale with the wordmark attached, and the old developer's favicon is a fuzzy blur that cannot be traced or upscaled, so vectorise the emblem from the foil presentation-folder photograph, where it sits alone and large, and isolate it as its own artwork.
trajectory.judgement: The favicon is a decoy: tracing or enlarging it returns mush. The foil emblem is a metallic gradient, not one flat colour, so the selection has to name the compass rose's own drawn character and the foil has to be flattened to the single Compass Brass ink before it will trace, and its centre ring and point gaps cannot be punched by a background removal.
trajectory.produces: A clean standalone compass-rose emblem as scalable vector with the centre ring and the triangular point gaps intact, plus a note on why the favicon was not used.

trajectory.action: Build the mark into a working family from the recovered lockup and emblem: the primary vertical lockup, the standalone emblem, a horizontal lockup with the emblem beside a single-line wordmark for the site header and letterhead, and a reversed colourway in Paper White ink for the Federal Navy ground.
trajectory.judgement: A firm judged by a trustee needs one mark that behaves the same everywhere, not four unrelated drawings. The reversed colourway is the trap the pages actually hit, because the counters that read as paper showing through become navy plugs the moment the ground goes dark unless the ink and its counters are inverted deliberately rather than by a fill.
trajectory.produces: Four vector variants that read as one system, each placeable on a coloured ground with no opaque background.

trajectory.action: Derive the multi-format production kit the rebuild carries the mark in and prove each variant at its own reproduction size: a favicon-scale raster, a square social-avatar tile on a house ground, the print card-corner mark, and the letterhead and footer vector, rendering each at its true target size rather than judging them all at lockup scale.
trajectory.judgement: A mark that is perfect at lockup scale is not proven at 32 px or at the card corner. The hairline strokes between the eight points fuse and the open centre ring fills at small size, so the smallest formats may need a simplified emblem with heavier counters rather than the same vector scaled down, and the finding only exists once each format is rendered at size.
trajectory.produces: The multi-format mark kit with every format rendered and inspected at its true reproduction size.

trajectory.action: Convert both press files to native documents, export the interchange file from each, and read what each one actually exposes as addressable structure.
trajectory.judgement: Two files that print identically are not two copies of one document, and nothing outside the converted structure says which one can carry a per record portrait.
trajectory.produces: A frame inventory per press file: text frames, graphic frames with their integer item ids, bounds, applied faces, and the true story text reconstructed from the concatenated content runs.

trajectory.action: Normalise the roster export against the firm's own current list: resolve the extra row, resolve preferred against legal name, regularise the credential punctuation without altering any designation, and build the portrait column to the merge's own image column contract with filenames matching the agent's own outputs.
trajectory.judgement: Which discrepancies are the agent's to fix and which are the office manager's to confirm is itself a call, and regulated designations are copy that may be repunctuated only if the source is inconsistent, never reworded.
trajectory.produces: A normalised data source plus a written list of every row questioned and how it was resolved.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the reconstructed story text, validate it, prepare the merge template, then export the interchange file again from the prepared template and search it for every expected placeholder before merging anything.
trajectory.judgement: A success message is not verification. The only evidence a placeholder exists is finding it in the prepared document's own stories.
trajectory.produces: A prepared merge template with every field confirmed present by inspection.

trajectory.action: Merge to a native document, render the press run as one card per adviser in roster order, produce one single card file per adviser, and render the proofs at true print resolution at card trim.
trajectory.judgement: Identity is established by opening each file and reading the name on the card, not by the order a list of links came back in.
trajectory.produces: The press run, the per adviser files under verified names, and the proofs at print resolution.

trajectory.action: Search short generic queries for the room photograph, exclude generative tech candidates, shortlist against an institutional register, license the chosen frame and download it at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: A 240 px thumbnail is a proxy for composition only. Colour, the register of the people in it and whether it belongs beside these eight portraits are properties of the full resolution file.
trajectory.produces: One licensed camera scale room frame plus the rejected shortlist and the reason for the pick.

trajectory.action: Call the recommender once per typographic role, read the real numeric weights from the family style inventory, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole system.
trajectory.judgement: The recommender refuses to pair, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction, and it is being judged by trustees reading a credentials table rather than by a design audience.
trajectory.produces: A type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight, plus one embed kit.

trajectory.action: Author the four roots as one self contained document: the team page grid, the A4 capabilities leave-behind with the sectors and credentials as a genuine table, and the square and four by five announcement posts.
trajectory.judgement: Every portrait must be carried as embedded image data, family and weight must be declared on the text elements themselves, and each root must declare its own canvas size rather than accepting a global override.
trajectory.produces: One authored HTML document carrying four roots at four canvas sizes.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then read the returned per root markup for every root and the rendered preview for the first, and reconcile both against what was authored.
trajectory.judgement: Success is not fidelity. The preview shows the first root only, so every other root can be verified only from the returned markup, and constructs that were silently normalised or dropped are visible nowhere else.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document plus a reconciliation of authored intent against returned structure, root by root.

trajectory.action: Create the shared board and place the corrected eight, the mark and the licensed room frame for the partners to review, reading a partial success as partial and re-sending only what failed.
trajectory.judgement: The placement cap per call is real and a partial acceptance is reported as a success, so the count placed has to be checked rather than assumed.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with a verified item count and nothing silently dropped.

trajectory.action: Write the note: parameters per sitter with one line on why that sitter differs, the type system by role, what each press file turned out to be and which one the card run was built on, every roster row questioned and its resolution, which supplied source each mark variant was recovered from and why the old developer's favicon was not used, and every resize any tool reported.
trajectory.judgement: The next freelancer must not have to repeat the archaeology on the two press files, and the office must be able to add a partner without calling anybody.
trajectory.produces: The handover note and the source files behind every editable deliverable.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the house ground actually holds on all eight. The knockout onto one neutral ground reports success on every frame and each portrait looks entirely normal on its own, but on the two sitters whose suiting and hair sit within a hair of the backdrop's own value the cut bites into shoulder edge and takes a soft chew out of the hairline. Where an edge separates and where it dissolves is a property of this sitter against this backdrop under this morning's light, and no readout in the family reports edge quality. It also does not declare itself one portrait at a time: the bitten shoulder reads as an unusual jacket until the eight are laid in the grid the team page actually runs them in, where two silhouettes are visibly not the same kind of object as the other six.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it and competence cannot either, because the client's requirement is one plain ground across eight sitters and the only way to learn how each sitter's edge behaves against it is to cut it and look at the set. Nothing states it: the brief asks for the same plain ground and never mentions edges, value separation or masks, and the acceptance line about holding at the edge is the client's own standard rather than a disclosure. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a per sitter change of instrument, and for one sitter possibly abandoning the knockout entirely and correcting their original ground toward the house neutral instead.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Lay all eight in the grid and judge them as a grid. For each sitter whose edge failed, switch instrument: select the sitter by their own visual character rather than by the object, invert, and fill the surround to the house neutral so the edge comes from a selection rather than from subject detection, or leave that sitter on their original ground and bring that ground to the house neutral tonally. Then re-cut the common crop on whatever changed and re-judge the grid.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A team page in which two of eight partners have a chewed shoulder line and a halo where their hair meets the ground, on the page an investment committee reads before deciding whether to place a mandate, at the exact tier where uniformity is the entire signal.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the mark family survives at the sizes it is actually used. The vectorise reports success and every variant looks correct at lockup scale, but derived down the compass rose stops being a compass rose: at favicon scale and at the printed card-corner size the hairline strokes between the eight points fuse into a star-shaped blob and the open centre ring fills solid, and in the reversed navy-ground colourway the counters that read as paper showing through invert into navy plugs so the ring and the point gaps disappear. If the foil emblem was traced without first flattening its metallic gradient it also shatters into a dozen banded sub-paths that render as visible steps at size. None of this shows at the scale the mark is recovered at; it exists only once each derived format is rendered at its own true reproduction size.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it, because the emblem is legible at whatever scale it is drawn and only reproduction at the target format sizes exposes the counter collapse. Nothing states it: the brief asks for the mark on the pages and the printed card and never mentions favicons, avatars, counters or a minimum size, and the acceptance line about the mark holding at its reproduction size is the client's own standard. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a per-size art-direction decision, and for the smallest formats possibly a separate simplified emblem with heavier strokes and an enlarged centre ring rather than the same vector scaled down.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Render the favicon-scale raster and the card-corner mark at their true target pixel sizes and the reversed colourway on the navy ground, and judge legibility there. Where the points fuse or the ring closes, redraw the emblem for that size with heavier counters, or supply a size-specific simplified emblem for the small formats and keep the full-detail vector for large use. If the foil emblem banded, re-trace it after flattening the metallic gradient to the single brass ink. Then re-derive the kit and re-judge each format at size.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A new website whose browser favicon and whose networked announcement avatar show a navy blob instead of a compass rose, and printed introduction cards whose corner mark is a filled dot, so the firm's mark is illegible at exactly the small sizes it appears on most.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which of the two press files is a card and which is a picture of one. They print identically and neither the geometry, the file names nor the client's memory distinguishes them. Converted, one exposes separated text frames plus a real graphic frame with an integer item id, so a per adviser portrait can bind; the other collapses into a single continuous text story with no graphic frame at all, so it can carry copy by offset arithmetic but cannot carry a per record photograph by any route. Frame granularity from a press file is a property of how a now retired printer built the document, is under nobody's control, has no read ahead parameter, and is invisible until the interchange file is exported and read.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it: whichever file is converted first, the structure it yields is only knowable after conversion, and picking the 2025 file because it is newer is a coin toss rather than a method. Nothing states it, because the brief says both files are the card and asks for the card to be kept. It is not a propagation re-run, because what changes is which document the entire print spine is built on and therefore which mapping strategy applies, per frame replacement against separated frames versus ordered offset arithmetic inside one continuous story.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Convert and export the interchange file from both, inventory the frames in each, and build the whole card run on the one that exposes a bindable graphic frame. If the portrait bearing file is also the one whose copy sits in a single story, drive the copy fields by offset arithmetic computed from the reconstructed story text with same frame rows ordered so their positions hold against the original, and re-verify by searching the prepared template for every placeholder. If neither file can carry a portrait, say so to the client rather than shipping eight identical cards with one static face.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A run of eight introduction cards built on the flattened file, every name and credential correct, and the same partner's portrait printed on all eight of them, handed across the table after first meetings with eight different institutions.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed room frame belongs to this firm. Search returns a 240 px thumbnail, which carries composition and nothing else: the frame's true colour, its actual white balance, the register of dress and posture of any people in it, and how the whole thing sits at full size only exist once the licence is taken and the full resolution file is downloaded and put beside the eight corrected portraits. A frame that reads as a sober boardroom at thumbnail can arrive with a heavy tungsten cast, a neutral that is nothing like the house ground, and an occupant dressed for a different tier of firm entirely. Adjacency is the test and adjacency exists only after the download.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because a licence is the only route to the pixels and the licence is the commitment. Nothing states it: the brief asks for one photograph of a room and never mentions colour, register or matching, and the acceptance line about sitting with the eight portraits is the client's own standard. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a fresh art direction decision about what the top of the capabilities page shows, and possibly a second licence, which is a cost the agent must own and report.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Put the full resolution frame beside the eight at full size and judge it there. Either bring it to the house target with its own correction and re-judge adjacency, or crop it so the people who set the wrong register are out of it, which changes what the page header says about the firm, or license a different candidate from the shortlist and account for the second licence in the note.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A capabilities leave-behind whose header photograph is visibly a different colour world from the eight partners printed below it, showing a room that is not this kind of firm, handed to a trustee across a table.

deliverables.name: Northwind house portrait set, eight advisers plus one licensed room frame
deliverables.deliverable_class: isolation and cutout set brought to one graded house look
deliverables.spec: Eight portraits knocked onto one house neutral ground at one identical head and shoulders crop, corrected to one white point and one skin rendering across three sitting mornings, with edges that hold where the shoulder and hairline actually are, plus one licensed camera scale room frame graded into the same world. Delivered at the page, card and post sizes required, every output at or below its source dimensions, with a per sitter parameter log and one line on why each sitter differs from the others. One set with one look, not one portrait at several sizes.

deliverables.name: Adviser introduction card run, press cards plus per adviser files and proofs
deliverables.spec: One card per current adviser at 85 x 55 mm in roster order, card count equal to current adviser count, every card binding preferred name, credential designations verbatim, practice line, direct dial and email, plus that adviser's own portrait. Accompanied by one single card file per adviser, named to the adviser and identity verified by opening it, and by proofs rendered at true print resolution from the merged document. Produced by reverse engineering the surviving press file into a live merge template, so the template and a written record of which press file it came from and why are part of the handover.

deliverables.name: Team page, capabilities leave-behind and announcement posts as one editable document plus its source
deliverables.spec: A single native editable document carrying four roots at four canvas sizes: the team page grid, the A4 capabilities leave-behind, a square announcement post and a four by five announcement post. Live editable text in one licensed type system with the correct numeric weight per family, the sectors and credentials as a genuine table the office can edit, the recovered mark as placeable scalable artwork with its counters intact, and every portrait carried as embedded image data rather than a reference. Delivered with the self contained source it was authored from.

deliverables.name: Northwind mark system, a family of marks recovered to vector plus a multi-format production kit
deliverables.spec: The firm mark recovered and rebuilt as a working family rather than a single lockup: a primary vertical lockup (the compass rose over the two-line wordmark), a standalone compass-rose emblem, a horizontal lockup (the emblem beside a single-line wordmark for the site header and letterhead), and a reversed colourway in Paper White ink for the Federal Navy ground, each as placeable scalable vector with the compass rose's enclosed counters (the centre ring and the triangular gaps between the points) intact and no opaque background rectangle riding along. Recovered from three renderings that need three different instruments, the flat export tracing directly, the letterpress card needing an ink-colour selection, and the foil presentation folder needing its metallic gradient flattened to the single brass ink before it will trace, with the old developer's favicon rejected as unusable. Derived from the family into the multi-format production kit the rebuild carries the mark in: a favicon-scale raster, a square social-avatar tile on a house ground, the print card-corner mark, and the letterhead and footer vector, each proven at its own true reproduction size so the compass points stay separate and the centre ring stays open at the smallest use, with a simplified emblem substituted for the small formats where the full-detail vector would collapse. Delivered with the vector masters and a note recording which supplied source each variant was recovered from and why the favicon was not used.

deliverables.name: Handover note and shared partner review board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording the parameters applied per sitter with one line on why that sitter differs, the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight used, what each of the two press files turned out to be as editable structure and which one the card run was built on so the next freelancer need not repeat the archaeology, every roster row questioned and how it was resolved, which supplied source each mark variant was recovered from and why the old developer's favicon was not used, the licensing decision and any second licence, and every resize any tool reported. Paired with a persistent shareable board carrying the corrected eight, the mark and the licensed frame with nothing silently dropped.

decision_gates: Which deliverables go to the merge surface and which to authored canvases, given that the client wants the printed card kept and the pages editable in house.
Whether a frame carries one illuminant or two, and therefore whether a global correction or a confined one is the right instrument.
How far to push the window sitting toward the backdrop sittings before the sitters stop looking like themselves, versus naming a frame that cannot come.
Whether to knock a given sitter onto the house ground or to leave them on their own ground and bring that ground to the house neutral instead.
What to do about the remotely supplied frame, which is under the card's print need and cannot lawfully be enlarged.
Which of the two press files the entire print spine is built on, and what to tell the client about the one that is unusable.
The extra roster row and the preferred against legal name conflict: what is the agent's call, what is the office manager's to confirm, and how to say so.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the client's own text or to reconstruct the story independently from the exported document.
Whether a success message counts as verification, when nothing instructs the agent to re-export the prepared template and search for its own placeholders.
Which route produces the per adviser files, and whether identity is established by position in a returned list or by opening the file.
The two mark files, which need opposite instruments, and whether the compass rose's counters survive the route chosen.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged by a trustee reading a credentials table rather than by a design audience.
Whether the licensed room frame joins this firm at full resolution, and whether a second licence is worth its cost.

Whether the standalone emblem is recovered from the foil presentation-folder photograph or isolated out of the high-fidelity recovered lockup, whether the old developer's fuzzy favicon is used at all, and whether the foil's metallic gradient is flattened to the single brass ink before tracing.

Whether one vector scales to every mark format or the smallest formats, the favicon and the card corner, need a simplified emblem with heavier counters, and which reversed colourway the navy ground and the announcement posts carry.
why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these files into a frontier image model and it returns eight convincing corporate portraits. IDENTITY: these are Northwind's actual eight advisers, and a regenerated face is a different person on a page whose entire purpose is that an institutional buyer can identify who will manage the mandate. A firm cannot ship invented partners. SPEC: the client needs one printed introduction card per current adviser at 85 x 55 mm carrying regulated credential designations reproduced exactly, bound per record to that adviser's own portrait, plus separately named single card files that each contain the adviser their filename claims, plus proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the pages are defined by being editable, because credentials and sectors change and the office will not pay for a redo each time a designation is added. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did this placeholder actually get created, is this the adviser the card claims, does this edge hold, does this licensed room belong beside these eight. MARK SYSTEM: the firm's own compass-rose mark must be recovered as a working vector family and derived to the exact formats the rebuild carries it in, its counters holding from letterhead down to a 32 px favicon; a model that redraws a plausible compass rose invents a mark the firm does not use and cannot reproduce crisply at those sizes.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. MERGE SPINE: building a merge template from a bare press PDF end to end headlessly is verified (convert to native, export interchange, generate mapping, prepare template, with every field confirmed present by unzipping the round trip). One record per page is confirmed for the PDF branch, per record named files are confirmed by two routes with order verified, per row image binding through an at prefixed column plus an image map keyed to bare filenames is confirmed visually, and true 300 DPI at trim is confirmed through the render tool. The press file checkpoint rests on the documented finding that frame granularity from a PDF is not under your control: a continuous flow converted to exactly one text frame with zero graphic frames, while a version carrying placed images split into two text frames plus two graphic frames. The offset discipline rests on the documented finding that the mapping readout's text content is lossy and that the validator returns valid on internally consistent wrong arithmetic. IMAGING: straighten, adjustments masked and unmasked, select by prompt with returnBbox, select subject, invert, crop to bounds, crop and resize with its tradeoffs and detection confidence, remove background transparent and onto a solid hex, fill area, and vectorize are all verified headless. The knockout checkpoint rests on the documented findings that background removal reports success while producing wrong alpha on low separation subjects, that it silently downscales oversized inputs and reports it only in a tradeoffs entry, and that selection masks are hard binary with no anti aliasing so edge softness can only come from the alpha. Mark recovery rests on the verified select by prompt to invert to crop to vectorize chain, on the verified enclosed counter limitation of background removal, and on the verified need to strip path zero and inject a viewBox. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export, true mm print canvases, real tables with per cell backgrounds and strokes, inline SVG as native editable vector, and a genuinely editable document are verified; the rendition shows PAGE 1 ONLY so verification is split between rendition and returned markup, and the payload goes by uploaded URL because eight inlined portraits pass the 70 KB threshold. FONTS: recommend once per role, mandatory style inventory for the non standard numeric weight, name laundering before the kit, and the returned slug in the CSS, all verified. STOCK and BOARDS: short queries, contentType only and orientation never passed, licence and full resolution download verified at 7360 x 4912, board creation and placement verified with a twelve per call cap where 201 means partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no upscaling, no generative fill or object removal, no compositing, no OCR, no bleed or press preset gate, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no batch above 20. MARK FAMILY: deriving multiple variants and a multi-format kit from the recovered mark rests on the same verified select-by-prompt to invert to crop to vectorize chain plus verified crop-and-resize to target sizes and color-overlay for the reversed colourway and the house-ground tile; the counter-survival-at-reproduction-size checkpoint rests on the documented finding that vectorize output legible at lockup scale fuses thin counters when rendered at favicon and card-corner sizes, and the foil-source recovery on the documented finding that a metallic gradient traces as many banded sub-paths unless flattened to one ink first.
